import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD_X = 998244353;
    static final int MOD_Y = 1000000007;
    static long total_input;
    static int[] digits_arr = new int[15];
    static int[] base_arr = new int[15];
    static int res;
    static int[] diff_vals = new int[15];
    static int[] q1_list = new int[1000010];
    static int[] q2_list = new int[1000010];
    static long[] q2_sum_arr = new long[1000010];

    static long get_value(int[] arr, int len) {
        long val = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= len; i++)
            val = val * 10 + arr[i];
        return val;
    }

    static long get_rank(int[] arr, int len) {
        long count = 0;
        for (int d = 1; d <= digits_arr[0]; d++) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= Math.min(len, d); i++) {
                for (int j = (i == 1 ? 1 : 0); j < arr[i]; j++) {
                    long leftPart = 0, rightPart = 0;
                    for (int p = 1; p < i; p++)
                        leftPart = rightPart = leftPart * 10 + arr[p];
                    leftPart = rightPart = leftPart * 10 + j;
                    for (int p = i + 1; p <= d; p++)
                        leftPart = leftPart * 10;
                    for (int p = i + 1; p <= d; p++)
                        rightPart = rightPart * 10 + 9;
                    rightPart = Math.min(rightPart, total_input);
                    if (leftPart <= rightPart)
                        count += rightPart - leftPart + 1;
                }
            }
            if (d <= len) count++;
        }
        return count;
    }

    static int computeF(int[] arr, int len) {
        long val = (-get_value(arr, len) + get_rank(arr, len)) % MOD_X;
        if (val < 0) val += MOD_X;
        return (int) val;
    }

    static void dfs_range(int start, int end, int[] q, int v) {
        if (start == end) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= 9; i++)
                q[++q[0]] = (int)((v + 1L * i * diff_vals[start]) % MOD_X);
            return;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= 9; i++)
            dfs_range(start + 1, end, q, (int)((v + 1L * i * diff_vals[start]) % MOD_X));
    }

    static void do_update(int len, int idx, int val) {
        int[] backup = Arrays.copyOf(digits_arr, digits_arr.length);
        digits_arr[idx] = val;
        for (int p = idx + 1; p <= len; p++) digits_arr[p] = 0;
        int baseVal = computeF(digits_arr, len);
        for (int p = idx + 1; p <= len; p++) {
            digits_arr[p] = 1;
            diff_vals[p] = (computeF(digits_arr, len) + MOD_X - baseVal) % MOD_X;
            digits_arr[p] = 0;
        }
        if (len - idx == 0) {
            res = (res + baseVal) % MOD_Y;
            return;
        }
        if (len - idx == 1) {
            for (int p = 0; p <= 9; p++)
                res = (res + (int)(((long)baseVal + 1L * p * diff_vals[len]) % MOD_X)) % MOD_Y;
            return;
        }
        int mid = (len + idx) / 2;
        q1_list[0] = 0;
        q2_list[0] = 0;
        dfs_range(idx + 1, mid, q1_list, baseVal);
        dfs_range(mid + 1, len, q2_list, 0);
        Arrays.sort(q2_list, 1, q2_list[0] + 1);
        long sumQ2 = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= q2_list[0]; i++)
            sumQ2 = (sumQ2 + q2_list[i]) % MOD_Y;
        for (int i = 1; i <= q1_list[0]; i++) {
            int p = lowerBound(q2_list, 1, q2_list[0], MOD_X - q1_list[i]);
            res = (int)((res + sumQ2 + 1L * q2_list[q2_list[0]] * q1_list[i]) % MOD_Y);
            res = (int)((res + 1L * (q2_list[0] - p + 1) * (MOD_Y - MOD_X)) % MOD_Y);
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(int[] arr, int start, int end, int key) {
        int low = start, high = end;
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (arr[mid] >= key) high = mid;
            else low = mid + 1;
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        total_input = Long.parseLong(br.readLine().trim());
        long m = total_input;
        int len = 0;
        while (m > 0) {
            digits_arr[++len] = (int)(m % 10);
            m /= 10;
        }
        digits_arr = Arrays.copyOf(digits_arr, len + 1);
        // Reverse the array from index 1 to len
        for (int i = 1; i <= len / 2; i++) {
            int temp = digits_arr[i];
            digits_arr[i] = digits_arr[len - i + 1];
            digits_arr[len - i + 1] = temp;
        }
        digits_arr[0] = len;
        for (int d = 1; d <= len; d++) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= d; i++) {
                int l = (i == 1 ? 1 : 0);
                int r = (d == len ? digits_arr[i] - 1 : 9);
                for (int j = l; j <= r; j++) {
                    if (j != digits_arr[i]) do_update(d, i, j);
                }
            }
            res = (res + computeF(digits_arr, d)) % MOD_Y;
        }
        System.out.println(res);
    }
}
